description.value: Seymour's Pub is a North Shore community pub known for 22 beers on draught spanning local craft, domestic, and international selections, plus a scratch kitchen that makes its sauces and dressings fresh daily. The venue hosts live music, DJ nights, and broadcasts major sporting events on fifteen screens throughout the bar. A free parking lot with overnight allowance makes it accessible, and a twice-daily happy hour draws a regular local crowd.
